tomato_early_blight.summary: A common fungal leaf disease that starts on older, lower leaves.

steps.title: Remove affected leaves
steps.detail: Cut off leaves that show symptoms and put them in the garbage, not the compost.

apple_scab.summary: A fungal disease that causes dark, scabby spots on leaves and fruit.

steps.title: Rake up fallen leaves
steps.detail: The fungus survives winter on fallen leaves. Rake and remove them in the fall.

steps.title: Prune for air flow
steps.detail: Open up the canopy in late winter so leaves dry faster.
